PagerBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-embeddings, urgency=high, alert_id=INC-2247. Link: https://redwood.pd/alerts/INC-2247

Aisha: acked (oncall). I'm on it. :raised_hand:

Miguel: ping — is this customer-facing or internal batch?

Aisha: customers in EU are seeing 502/503 on embed requests, error rate ~65/min. Investigating.

Support: seeing 12 active tickets referencing embed timeouts, mostly EU region.

Aisha: quick infra check: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=embed-processor -o wide` shows 3 pods OOMKilled in eu-zone-2.

Sam: any autoscaler events?

Aisha: autoscaler attempted scale but new pods hit ImagePullBackOff in eu-zone-2. Error in node logs: `registry auth timeout`. So nodes couldn't pull image -> failed launches -> capacity loss -> overload on remaining replicas.

Miguel: okay that explains sudden 5xx spike. Suggest temporary traffic rebalancing to avoid full outage.

Aisha: plan: semi-auto reassign traffic off eu-zone-2 to eu-zone-1 and us-central, enable a small fallback model variant (lower mem) for a fraction of traffic. Steps from runbook:
1) apply route override
2) enable fallback variant for 10-50% (gradual)
3) notify customers
4) escalate registry/auth team if pull errors continue.

Carla: +1 to fallback model. `model=embed-small-q4` reduces memory, should cut OOM risk. Start with 10% then ramp if we still see 5xx.

Aisha: executing reroute now. Command: `infractl route override --service inference-embeddings --remove-zones eu-zone-2 --add-zones eu-zone-1,us-central --note "emergency reroute 1758200000"`

PagerBot: Action logged: reroute-request by Aisha at 1758200123. Runbook step 1 complete.

Aisha: applied route override and started canary of fallback model at 10%. Monitoring latency and 5xx.

Support: customer comms going out to top-10 impacted: "We’re mitigating an incident affecting embeddings in EU; traffic routed to alternate zones and we’ve enabled a temporary low-memory model variant. We’ll update in ~10m."

Miguel: checking KV cache and queue lengths — queues spiked during the initial overload but token backlog dropping after reroute.

Sam: can we reassign PD ownership? I'm on a customer call for the next 30m.

Aisha: handing over. Miguel, can you take operator oncall for this incident? If yes, ack in PD and monitor.

Miguel: taking it now. ack -> "Miguel (oncall-infra)". Brief: cause=registry auth timeout -> failed pod pulls in eu-zone-2 -> capacity loss -> 5xx spike. Mitigation applied: reroute, fallback variant, customer notifications.

Aisha: copying runbook notes and metrics into the incident channel. Will remain available for escalation. :thumbsup:

PagerBot: incident update: status=partial_mitigation, owner=Miguel, severity=high, customer-impact=limited. Next automated check in 10m.

Miguel: 1758200523 - follow-up: 5xx rate down ~85% from peak, queue backlog cleared to baseline. Recommend keep route override and fallback for 1h while registry/auth team confirms image pull stability.

Support: customers updated that mitigations are in place and we’ll follow up with post-incident notes.

Miguel: will open a postmortem doc and add a playbook item to detect registry auth failures earlier (alert on ImagePullBackOff ratio + autoscaler failures).

Aisha: thanks all — great quick coordination. I’ll help with the postmortem and playbook edits.
